g.text: D: one complete clone removed at t=0; U: unchanged matched three-clone colony. Each condition has 81 equal samples (0,20,…,1600).
Ratios display exact reduced fractions; zero U makes retention undefined, never zero. D/U>1 may reflect release from crowding.
Fixed four-identity structural registry; V01/RV01 share an identity. Unknown and unregistered types omitted; not total viable population.
Ages denote completed preparation updates. Finite constructed conditions, not independent ecological histories or evolvability measures.
